title: 167. Merge Strings Alternately

examples.explanation: The merged string will be merged as so: word1:  a   b   c word2:    p   q   r merged: a p b q c r
Notice that as word2 is longer, "rs" is appended to the end. word1:  a   b word2:    p   q   r   s merged: a p b q   r   s
Notice that as word1 is longer, "cd" is appended to the end. word1:  a   b   c   d word2:    p   q merged: a p b q c   d

hints: Use two pointers, one for each string, and alternately append characters.
When one pointer reaches the end, append the remainder of the other string.
